features.description: Classify the Grok MCP package into usable components, unsafe components, and NEXUS integration candidates.
features.done_gate: Result artifact cites local extracted paths and separates evidence from readiness claims.

features.description: Convert MCP red-team scenarios MCP-01 through MCP-06 into NEXUS test backlog items.
features.done_gate: Each scenario maps to one concrete test idea, expected block condition, and allowed fixture path.

features.description: Design a read-only Grok custom MCP tool surface over NEXUS state digest and evidence lookup.
features.done_gate: Tool list excludes shell, git, delete, arbitrary file write, connector send, and secret access.

features.description: Propose a controller loop that validates Grok outbox artifacts before any NEXUS integration.
features.done_gate: Controller loop includes retry, rejection, forbidden-action, and no-progress stop conditions.

features.description: Review the OpenRouter Auto integration report and propose low-risk Grok harness tasks that can use auto-routed model calls for schema checking or artifact triage.
features.done_gate: Proposal keeps Grok as proposal-only, requires served_model logging, and excludes high-risk verifier or side-effect authority.
